scene.ko: 사진을 보여 주며 어깨 길이에 층을 내고 숱을 쳐 달라고 원하는 스타일을 설명하고, 집에서 손질하는 법을 묻는다.

lines.en: So, what are we doing today?
I'd like something like this. Here's a picture.
lines.ko: 이런 느낌으로 하고 싶어요. 여기 사진이요.
alt: I want something like this picture.
Something like this, please. I have a photo.

lines.en: Nice. So, shoulder length with some layers?
lines.ko: 예쁘네요. 그러니까 어깨 길이에 층을 좀 내는 거죠?

lines.en: Yes. And could you thin it out a little? My hair is really thick.
lines.ko: 네. 그리고 숱 좀 쳐 주실 수 있어요? 머리숱이 정말 많아서요.
alt: Yes. Can you also thin it out a bit? I have very thick hair.
That's right. My hair is thick, so could you thin it a little?

lines.en: Sure. Do you want bangs like in the picture?
Maybe just some light side bangs. I don't want them too short.
lines.ko: 옆으로 넘기는 가벼운 앞머리 정도요. 너무 짧은 건 싫어요.
alt: Just some light side bangs, please. Not too short.
Side bangs would be nice, but not too short.

lines.en: Got it... All done. What do you think?
I love it. How should I style it at home?
lines.ko: 정말 마음에 들어요. 집에서는 어떻게 손질하면 돼요?
alt: It looks great. How do I style it at home?
I really like it. Any tips for styling it at home?

lines.en: Just blow-dry it with a round brush, and put a little hair oil on the ends.
lines.ko: 둥근 빗으로 드라이하고 끝에 헤어 오일을 조금 바르시면 돼요.

expressions.ko: 숱 좀 쳐 주실 수 있어요?

expressions.en: How should I style it at home?
